audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Within-modality masking conditions on the other modality in pinned source; Unimodal output modules absent from optimizer and checkpoint traversal; Raw flattened R2 does not subtract the trial-average time course.
limitations: P1 — Within-modality masking conditions on the other modality in pinned source — Counterevidence: This is training-task mismatch, not test-set leakage; release postdates paper

P1 — Within-modality masking conditions on the other modality in pinned source — Counterevidence and alternatives: A jointly conditioned reconstruction task is itself legitimate; it is different from the specifically printed E[Xmasked|Xvisible]. This is not held-out test leakage. No empirical dependence on extra information is guaranteed, and the public 2026 snapshot is not established as the 2025 experimental code.

P2 — Unimodal output modules absent from optimizer and checkpoint traversal — Counterevidence: Encoder can learn through a fixed head; matching initialization can accidentally reproduce head; no historical version identity assumed

P2 — Unimodal output modules absent from optimizer and checkpoint traversal — Counterevidence and alternatives: Autograd still propagates through a fixed head, so the encoder can learn. Recreating the same hidden initialization may reproduce a fixed head by coincidence, and explicit external registration could in principle repair it, but none occurs along the checked construction/update/save paths. No historical checkpoint score change is asserted.
P3 — Raw flattened R2 does not subtract the trial-average time course — Counterevidence: Raw R2 is a valid different metric; published-run implementation unknown

P3 — Raw flattened R2 does not subtract the trial-average time course — Counterevidence: The paper gives no separate residual-metric equation; trial-average wording could mean ordinary centering. Major scope is limited to residual-variability interpretation.

P3 — Raw flattened R2 does not subtract the trial-average time course — Counterevidence and alternatives: The paper gives no separate residual-metric equation. Accounting for the trial average could be loose wording for ordinary centering; its intended interpretation therefore needs clarification. Raw R2 is valid for total predictive variation and is not itself an incorrect score. A real pretrained dataset might differ from the checked preparation path, and the historical code/score correspondence is unknown.
P4 — Singleton session group skipped after scalar squeeze — Counterevidence: Many-example single-session batches avoid this boundary

P4 — Singleton session group skipped after scalar squeeze — Counterevidence and alternatives: Large single-session batches avoid the edge case. The prevalence depends on sampler composition, and no missing-example frequency is inferred from raw data. A decoder bias, if present, still supplies a constant output.

P5 — Embedding ablation description overstates consistent benefit — Counterevidence and alternatives: Generally improve can be read as an overall qualitative statement rather than strict dominance; this is a wording qualification, not evidence that measured rows are false. Marginal standard deviations do not identify the uncertainty of paired session differences.

assumptions: Operative assumptions: Multimodal mode with ordinary self-spike or self-behavior task and no selected-variable encoding override. In the inspected code 1 means masked, 0 visible; modalities in the multimodal input map all reach the shared transformer. Counterexample: masked X is an equiprobable bit, same-modality visible features constant, Y=X.

Operative assumptions: The unimodal encoding/decoding branch calls init_unimodal_stitcher before optimizer construction. Its newly constructed decoder modules are not the distinct registered multimodal modules. A registered ParameterDict nested inside an ordinary parent dict is still not reachable from the parent module traversal.

Operative assumptions: The definite code claim concerns the returned scalar from the inspected release. For the counterexample both trials share one task condition; the observed mean time course is (0,10), so global-over-trials and condition-specific trial averages coincide. The stronger scientific interpretation means residual variance after removing that time course, rather than ordinary total-sample variance about one grand mean.
Operative assumptions: A batch has exactly one sample for some session, e.g. session IDs (a,b,b). np.argwhere returns shape(1,1), and unqualified squeeze makes its index a zero-dimensional scalar.
Operative assumptions: Compare single-session ablations with single-session NEDS, not the larger multi-session model. Positive point differences are not treated as significance tests.
